records.evidenceNote: The official Cornell biography explicitly places the UC Berkeley Simons fellowship after CMU graduation and before the joint Harvard/MIT postdoc. The completed CMU PhD is dated 2022. LinkedIn reports the Simons role August–December 2022, while the CV says Fall 2022; the explicit relative sequence supports the first documented new post-degree appointment despite an unknown formal conferral month. Research fellow is retained as other academic, not assumed postdoc.
